scope: Field-filtered structured observability, not full component logs or full shared memory
limitations: Not all runtime polls and worker outputs were logged in every game.
Reviewer selection and pipeline completion do not establish delivery.
Short reviewer pros/cons are emitted assessments, not hidden model reasoning or causal explanations.
Only selected worker updates are included; full snapshots and participant profiles are omitted.
Event order is relative; source wall-clock times, original game IDs and process IDs are omitted.
